2607.12612.title: Translation as a Computationally Efficient Bridge: Feasibility of English BERT for Low-Resource Languages
2607.12612.paper_summary: BERT models have revolutionised Natural Language Processing (NLP) through their ability to process unstructured text across diverse domains. However, developing high-quality BERT models for non-English languages remains challenging due to limited annotated data and high computational demands. Translating non-English data into English and fine-tuning existing English BERT models offers a resource-efficient alternative, yet few studies have structurally compared translation-based fine-tuning with native-language BERT performance across tasks and languages. This study provides such a comparison, evaluating the feasibility of translation-based fine-tuning across six NLP tasks: Sentiment Analysis, Hate Speech Detection, Question Answering, Named Entity Recognition, Part-of-Speech Tagging, and Natural Language Inference, using datasets translated from Bulgarian, Chinese, Dutch, Italian, and Russian. Across all settings, the translation-based approach was comparable or superior in 53.3 percent of cases. Gains were most frequent in Question Answering, Part-of-Speech Tagging, and Natural Language Inference, while performance declines were common in Named Entity Recognition and Hate Speech Detection. The results show that translation-based fine-tuning is most effective for tasks relying on syntactic or structural patterns and for languages typologically close to English, such as Dutch, but less effective for token-level or culturally nuanced tasks, particularly in Chinese. Overall, this study demonstrates that translation-based fine-tuning offers a scalable, resource-efficient, and empirically validated path for extending NLP to low-resource languages while advancing linguistic inclusivity and sustainability in artificial intelligence.
2607.12612.paper_summary_zh: BERT 模型透過其處理各種領域非結構化文本的能力，徹底改變了自然語言處理 (NLP)。然而，由於標註數據有限和計算需求高，為非英語語言開發高質量的 BERT 模型仍然具有挑戰性。將非英語數據翻譯成英語並微調現有的英語 BERT 模型提供了一種資源高效的替代方案，但少數研究在結構上比較了基於翻譯的微調與母語 BERT 在各任務和語言中的表現。本研究提供了這樣的比較，評估了基於翻譯的微調在六個 NLP 任務中的可行性：情感分析、仇恨言論檢測、問題回答、命名實體識別、詞性標註和自然語言推理，使用從保加利亞語、中文、荷蘭語、意大利語和俄語翻譯的數據集。在所有設置中，基於翻譯的方法在 53.3% 的情況下可與或優於其他方法。問題回答、詞性標註和自然語言推理中的增益最為頻繁，而命名實體識別和仇恨言論檢測中的表現下降則較為常見。結果顯示，基於翻譯的微調對依賴於句法或結構模式的任務以及與英語類型學上相近的語言（如荷蘭語）最為有效，但對於基於詞元或文化細微差異的任務（特別是在中文中）則效果較差。總體而言，本研究表明，基於翻譯的微調提供了一條可擴展的、資源高效的、經實證驗證的路徑，以擴展 NLP 到低資源語言，同時促進人工智慧的語言包容性和可持續性。
